label.zh_CN: ISO 16:1975 标准调音频率（A4 = 440 Hz）
label.zh_TW: ISO 16:1975 標準調音頻率（A4 = 440 Hz）
label.ja_JP: ISO 16:1975 標準調律周波数（A4 = 440 Hz）

standards.evidence: ISO official RSS: stage 90.93 reviewed 2022-09-30, TC/SC ISO/TC 43, ICS 17.140.01. ISO abstract archive: 'Specifies the frequency for the note A in the treble stave and shall be 440 Hz' with +/-0.5 Hz tuning accuracy.
standards.caveat: Full normative text is paid; only official catalogue record, abstract archive and public cover preview are stored.

standards.authority: 国家标准局 / 全国声学标准化技术委员会

label.zh_CN: GB/T 3451-1982 标准调音频率（A4 = 440 Hz）
label.zh_TW: GB/T 3451-1982 標準調音頻率（A4 = 440 Hz）
label.ja_JP: GB/T 3451-1982 標準調律周波数（A4 = 440 Hz）

standards.evidence: Official openstd.samr.gov.cn catalogue record for GB/T 3451-1982 '标准调音频率 / Standard tuning frequency', issued 1982-12-31, effective 1983-10-01, currently active; the standard is a non-equivalent adoption of ISO 16:1975 (440 Hz).
standards.caveat: Official full-text PDF unavailable locally (TLS name mismatch); catalogue records and scope archives only. The 440 Hz value follows the ISO 16 adoption relation.

label.zh_CN: ISO/R 16:1955 早期 ISO 建议（A4 = 440 Hz）
label.zh_TW: ISO/R 16:1955 早期 ISO 建議（A4 = 440 Hz）
label.ja_JP: ISO/R 16:1955 初期 ISO 勧告（A4 = 440 Hz）

standards.evidence: ISO 16:1975 catalogue overview: 'ISO 16 replaced the earlier ISO Recommendation R 16-1955 with technically identical specifications'.
standards.caveat: Withdrawn recommendation; retained for historical comparison only.

label.ja_JP: 1939 ロンドン国際会議（A4 = 440 Hz）

standards.evidence: Archived Concert pitch article: the 1939 London international conference agreed A = 440 Hz, later codified by ISO 16.
standards.caveat: Conference recommendation, not an ISO publication.

label.zh_CN: 1834 斯图加特会议 Scheibler 方案（A4 = 440 Hz）
label.zh_TW: 1834 斯圖加特會議 Scheibler 方案（A4 = 440 Hz）
label.ja_JP: 1834 シュトゥットガルト会議 Scheibler 案（A4 = 440 Hz）

standards.evidence: Archived Concert pitch article: the 1834 Stuttgart Conference recommended C264 (A440) based on Scheibler's tonometer; Ellis (1878) discusses forks of 440 double vibrations compared with the French diapason normal.
standards.caveat: Historical proposal, not a published standard.

label.en_US: Diapason normal 1859 — French national standard (A4 = 435 Hz)
label.ja_JP: 1859 フランス diapason normal（A4 = 435 Hz）

standards.evidence: Ellis, Nature 1878: 'Pitch of the French Diapason Normal ... 435 vib. doubles' and comparison with Scheibler's 440 fork. Archived Concert pitch article: the 16 February 1859 law set A above middle C at 435 Hz, the first large-scale pitch standardisation.
standards.caveat: Historical national standard, superseded; not an ISO standard.

label.zh_CN: 科学音高 C4 = 256 Hz（A4 ≈ 430.54 Hz）
label.zh_TW: 科學音高 C4 = 256 Hz（A4 ≈ 430.54 Hz）
label.ja_JP: 科学的音高 C4 = 256 Hz（A4 ≈ 430.54 Hz）

standards.evidence: Archived Concert pitch article: 'scientific pitch fixes middle C at 256 Hz ... which places the A above it at approximately 430.54 Hz in equal temperament tuning'.
standards.caveat: Historical mathematical proposal; the exact equal-tempered value is 256*2^(9/12) = 430.5389646 Hz, rounded here to 430.54 Hz.

label.ja_JP: ヴェルディ音高 / A = 432 Hz

standards.evidence: Archived Concert pitch article discusses A = 432 Hz as an alternative standard; Tunable concert pitch reference lists 432 Hz with a full chromatic frequency table.
standards.caveat: Not a published standards document; no ISO 16 relationship.

label.en_US: Baroque convention A = 415 Hz (exact semitone down: 415.305 Hz)
label.zh_CN: 巴洛克惯例 A = 415 Hz（精确低半音 415.305 Hz）
label.zh_TW: 巴洛克慣例 A = 415 Hz（精確低半音 415.305 Hz）
label.ko_KR: 바로크 관습 A = 415 Hz(정확한 반음 아래 415.305 Hz)
label.ja_JP: バロック慣例 A = 415 Hz（正確な半音下 415.305 Hz）

standards.evidence: Archived Concert pitch article: 'Many modern ensembles who specialize in the performance of Baroque music have agreed on a standard of A = 415 Hz. An exact equal-tempered semitone lower than 440 Hz would be 415.305 Hz, though this is rounded to the nearest integer'.
standards.caveat: Performance convention, not a standards publication.

label.ja_JP: ヘンデル 1740 音叉 A = 422.5 Hz

label.zh_CN: 乐团惯例 A = 442 Hz（欧洲 / 研究常用）
label.zh_TW: 樂團慣例 A = 442 Hz（歐洲／研究常用）
label.ko_KR: 오케스트라 관습 A = 442 Hz(유럽 / 연구 기본값)
label.ja_JP: オーケストラ慣例 A = 442 Hz（欧州／研究既定値）

standards.evidence: Feichtner (2024) dissertation, p.27/p.50: MIDI conversion uses 442 Hz with note 69 as A4, and 'The decision to set the pitch standard to 442 Hz was the result of the listing of the pitch standard frequencies of the most famous orchestras (Table 2)'. Wikipedia archive: 1964 survey found US orchestras at 441/442 Hz; Tunable reference lists 442 Hz.
standards.caveat: Orchestral convention, explicitly NOT an ISO standard.
